_comment: What an sglang PD-disaggregated manifest from mad-slurm-multinode needs added to become measurable. Merge into the base manifest, do not use standalone: `jq -s '.[0] * .[1]' base.json sglang-disagg.overlay.json > run_manifest_prof.json`. Fill every <FILL_...> first, and add the /run_logs bind by hand as the README describes -- it is an edit to a string the base manifest already has, which a merge cannot express. PROFILE_ENABLE=1 is the single switch: MAD's scripts/sglang_disagg/sglang_disagg_mori_io_ep.sh reads it and adds --disable-custom-all-reduce and --disable-cuda-graph to both roles, in the MODEL_CONFIG strings every node interpolates. RDMA_COUNTERS=1 samples the adapters alongside; it degrades nothing, so it is also the one line here worth keeping on a tuned run. It needs `-v /sys/devices:/sys/devices:ro` appended to additional_docker_run_options BY HAND: this overlay cannot do it, because a jq merge replaces that string rather than appending to it -- the same limitation as the /run_logs bind above. Without the mount /sys/class/infiniband reaches the container as symlinks whose targets are absent, and the sampler finds ten adapters and no counters (measured). Setting those flags at a launch site instead profiled three nodes out of four (job 25824). Explanations live in _comment_* keys beside a block, never inside it: madengine turns each key of an env block into a variable.

context._comment_tools: No `tools` block here on purpose. madengine wraps the model run command, which for a disaggregated launcher is `bash run.sh` -- the orchestration, not the work: a four-node run profiled 668 shell helpers and no server, so the block cost a slower job and produced nothing. Wrapping the server itself was then tried from the launcher and the servers would not unwind under the profiler either; see references/measurement-setup.md before adding either back. The power and VRAM profilers, if wanted, belong in a block of their own.
context._comment_docker_env_vars: The base template ships NCCL_DEBUG=WARN, which logs nothing to parse. SGLANG_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR is what makes /start_profile write anything: without it the profile point is a silent no-op. RCCL_LOG_DIR gives each server process its own RCCL file (NCCL_DEBUG_FILE) instead of eight ranks overwriting each other in one stdout, which is where the torn records and the invented topology edges come from; it must sit under /run_logs so the analysis outside the container can read it. PROFILE_ROLES decides which reports exist, one per role, and the role's log is also where the tooling reads which trace directory belongs to which role. PROFILE_CONCURRENCY matches the benchmark point being characterised.

deployment_config._comment_env_vars: The same variables at launcher level: a value set only here never reaches the workload, and a value set only in the container block is missing from the sbatch environment.
